Game Overview

At its heart, Watermelon Day is a adventure game about guide the charming Watermelon boy through a vibrant 2D world, dodging foes and traps while collecting life-saving water. With intuitive controls and escalating challenges across eight levels, perfect your double jumps to uncover the secrets behind each flag, hinting at even tougher adventures ahead.
